database-tests.root_cause: The Solo worker changed only the unchanged-renewal fixture price assertion from the parent 8151.84 to 10151.84, before the fixture creates any revised price terms. The preceding fixture approves Multi-2 annual at 8151.84, and the unchanged renewal deliberately uses that exact current catalog term. The migrated submit_shop_billing_notice preserves current terms when no new plan/term is requested; the frozen list price is correctly 8151.84. Restoring that original business assertion alone makes the entire catalog SQL fixture pass against the migrated local schema; trial, prices, quotas, snapshots, replay, negotiated offers and historical terms assertions remain. This is verifier-fixture evidence, not a billing implementation defect. The blocked mandatory SQL check remains required and unrun until re-verification; no PASS or own receipt is manufactured.
